Label: statement
Definition: A statement about an entity, such as a person or a process, to state details about it.

Label: statement about a human
Definition: A statement that describes a human.

Label: statement about a patient
Definition: A statement regarding a patient to state details about them.

Label: statement about a phenotype
Definition: A statement regarding a phenotype to state details about it.

Label: statement about a procedure
Definition: A statement regarding a procedure to describe it.

Label: statement about a consent
Definition: A statement regarding a consent to describe it.

Label: Date of assessment
Definition: The date when an entity is assessed.

Label: Date of resolution
Definition: The date when an abnormal disposition, such as a disease or a phenotypic abnormality, disapears.

Label: Year of onset
Definition: The year in which an entity appears.

Label: Year of birth
Definition: The year in which the birth occurs.

Label: Year of diagnosis
Definition: The year in which the diagnosis is made.

Label: Year of assessment
Definition: The year of the assessment of an entity, e.g. the year when a phenotype is assessed by medical evidence.

Label: Year of resolution
Definition: The year of the resolution of an abnormal disposition, e.g. the year when a phenotype ceases existing.

Label: Year of death
Definition: The year in which the death occurs.

Label: Age
Definition: Elapsed time since birth expressed in years.

Label: Age at death
Definition: Elapsed time between birth and death expressed in years.

Label: Age Category
Definition: Arbitrary interval of age to split a population into groups according to their age.

Label: Adulthood
Definition: Age category including people of 16 years old and above.

Label: Late adulthood
Definition: Age category including people of 60 years old and above.

Label: Middle adulthood
Definition: Age category including people between 40 and 59 years old (inclusive).

Label: Young adulthood
Definition: Age category including people between 16 and 39 years old (inclusive).

Label: Early young adulthood
Definition: Age category including people between 16 and 18 years old (inclusive).

Label: Intermediate young adulthood
Definition: Age category including people between 19 and 24 years old (inclusive).

Label: Late young adulthood
Definition: Age category including people between 25 and 39 years old (inclusive).

Label: Antenatal age
Definition: Age category prior to birth.

Label: Embryonal
Definition: Age category up to 8 weeks following fertilization, corresponding to 10 weeks of gestation (inclusive).

Label: Fetal
Definition: Age prior to birth but after 8 weeks of embryonic development (corresponding to a gestational age of 10 weeks).

Label: Late first trimester
Definition: Category prior to birth in the first trimester during the early fetal period, which is defined as 11 to 13 weeks of gestation (inclusive).

Label: Second trimester
Definition: Category prior to birth during the second trimester, which comprises the range of gestational ages from 14 to 27 weeks of gestation (inclusive).

Label: Third trimester
Definition: Category prior to birth during the third trimester, which is defined as 28 weeks and zero days (28+0) of gestation and beyond.

Label: Neonatal age
Definition: Age within the first 28 days of life.

Label: Pediatric age
Definition: Age category before adulthood, defined here as before the age of 16 years, but excluding neonatal or congenital onset. It includes people from the age of 28 days to 15 years old (included).

Label: Childhood
Definition: Age category including people from 1 to 4 years old (inclusive).

Label: Infantile age
Definition: Age category including people from 28 days to under 1 year old.

Label: Juvenile age
Definition: Age category including people between 5 and 15 years old (inclusive).

Label: Perimenopausal age
Definition: Age category including people undergoing perimenopause, i.e. the period of life shortly before the occurence of the menopause.

Label: Postmenopausal age
Definition: Age category including people undergoing postmenopause, i.e. the period of life after the occurrence of the menopause.

Label: Puerpural age
Definition: Age category including ages refering to childbirth or period after immediately following.

Label: Sex at birth
Definition: The physical sexual characteristiscs at birth.

Label: Female sex at birth
Definition: Physical sexual characteristiscs at birth that are stated as female.

Label: Intersex at birth
Definition: Physical sexual characteristiscs at birth that are stated as intersex.

Label: Male sex at birth
Definition: Physical sexual characteristiscs at birth that are stated as male.

Label: Patient sex at birth unknown
Definition: Physical sexual characteristiscs at birth that are unknown.

Label: Sex at birth not recorded
Definition: Physical sexual characteristiscs at birth that are not recorded.

Label: Female gender identity
Definition: Gender identity of a person that identifies as a girl or as a woman.

Label: Identifies as nonbinary gender
Definition: Gender identity of a person that identifies nor as a male nor as a female gender.

Label: Male gender identity
Definition: Gender identity of a person that identifies as a boy or as a man.

Label: Gender identity unknown
Definition: Gender identity of a person that is unknown.

Label: Gender identity not recorded
Definition: Gender identity of a person that is unknown because unrecorded.

Label: Nb of previous pregnancies
Definition: Number of precious pregnancies of an individual that includes pregancies that did not reach their end.

Label: Consent status
Definition: A status of the consent of a person.

Label: Pending
Definition: A status of a consent that is waiting to be defined.

Label: Proposed
Definition: A status of a consent that has been proposed to a person for them to decide.

Label: Active
Definition: A status of a consent that has been approved by the concerned person.

Label: Rejected
Definition: A status of a consent that has been rejected by the concerned person.

Label: Inactive
Definition: A status of a consent that is inactive.

Label: Entered in Error
Definition: A status of a consent that has been entered by error.

Label: Date of consent
Definition: The date when the consent status has been updated.

Label: Consent type
Definition: The type of consent given by a person that precises the details of what is consented

Label: Agreement to be contacted for research purpose
Definition: An agreement given by a patient to be contacted by research teams for research purposes.

Label: Consent to the reuse of data
Definition: A consent given by a person to the reuse of their data.

Label: Unrecorded handedness
Definition: An handedness that is unrecorded.

Label: Risk of fall assessed
Definition: A patient with phenotypes that allow to assess the patient undergo a risk of fall. (quality?)

Label: Phenotypically related body structure
Definition: A body structure related to a phenotype such that the body structure is the location of the phenotype.

Label: Phenotypically related anatomical entity
Definition: An anatomical entity related to a phenotype such that the anatomical entity is the location of the phenotype. In other words, the phenotype is a disposition of the anatomical entity.

Label: Body structure related anatomical entity
Definition: An anatomical entity that is located in a body structure.

Label: patient
Definition: A patient that had received a confirmed diagnostic of genetic mutation and that is involved in the data collection for natural history study of their disease.

Label: unkown life status
Definition: A life status that is unkown.

Label: unrecorded life status
Definition: A life status that is unkown because unrecorded.

Label: lost in follow up
Definition: A unkown life status because of the patient being lost in follow up.

Label: opt out
Definition: A unkown life status because of the patient being opted out from the study.

Label: variant origin unknown
Definition: A variant origin that is unknown.

Label: variant origin unrecorded
Definition: A variant origin that is unknown because unrecorded.

Label: presence qualifier
Definition: A qualifier for stating the presence, absence or uncertainty of a entity instance (e.g. a phenotype instance).

Label: absent
Definition: A qualifier for an instance of a entity which is absent.

Label: present
Definition: Qualifies an instance of an entity as present.

Label: presence unsure
Definition: Qualifies an instance of an entity as unsure.

Label: presence unrecorded
Definition: A presence or absence that is unrecorded

Label: abnormal disposition
Definition: A disposition that differs from the norm, such as a disease or a phenotypic abnormality.

Label: Activity related body function
Definition: A body function that is involved in an activity. The boby function is needed in order to fullfill the activity.

Label: Body function related phenotype
Definition: A phenotype that affects a body function.

Label: Activity related phenotype
Definition: A phenotype that affects an activity.

Label: Double compound motor action potential abnormality
Definition: Two abnormal findings in a compound motor action potential measurement in EMG.

Label: Fatigue while eating
Definition: A fatigue that occurs when the subject is eating

Label: Difficulty walking short distance
Definition: A difficulty to walk short distance. E.g. a difficulty to  walk inside a building such as a house.

Label: Difficulty changing basic position
Definition: A difficulty to change basic position. E.g. a difficulty to go from a sitting position to a standing position.

Label: Anhedonia while eating
Definition: An anhedonia that occurs when the subject is eating

Label: Dysphagia for solid
Definition: Difficulty in swallowing solid food.

Label: Dysphagia for liquid
Definition: Difficulty in swallowing liquid food. This is distinct from hydrophobia.

Label: Fatiguable weakness of facial musculature
Definition: A type of weakness of the facial musculature (i.e. one or more muscles innervated by the seventh cranial nerve) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of the strength of the facial musculature with repetitive muscle actions.

Label: Fatiguable weakness of the ocular muscles
Definition: A type of weakness of the ocular muscles that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of the strength of the ocular muscles with repetitive muscle actions.

Label: Fatiguable weakness of axial muscles
Definition: A type of weakness of the axial muscles (i.e., of the muscles of the head and neck, spine, and ribs) that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of the strength of the axial muscles with repetitive muscle actions.

Label: Weakness of chewing muscles
Definition: A lack of strength in the muscles involved in chewing.

Label: Phenotypically related procedure
Definition: A procedure that can assess a phenotype.

Label: Body function related procedure
Definition: A procedure that can measure a body function.

Label: Body structure related procedure
Definition: A procedure that can measure a body structure.

Label: Activity related procedure
Definition: A procedure that can measure an activity.

Label: Assessment of expiratory and cough peak flows using an expiratory flowmeter
Definition: A test assessing the subject’s expiratory peak flow when they expirate and when they cough. It assesses the glottis efficiency to clear out the repiratory tract by using an expiratory flowmeter.
Assesses Function (label): Functions of coughing|Respiratory muscle functions|Functions of breathing through the mouth|Respiration functions

Label: Quantative muscle testing
Definition: Measurement of maximum isometric force generation from a muscle group; performed with specialized equipment.

Label: Assessment using Dysphagimeter
Definition: An assessment that uses the Dysphagimeter scale to assess dysphagia or swallowing impairements. The Dysphagimeter is a patient-reported questionnaire that measures the ability to swallow foods of different textures and the impact of dysphagia on activities and participation. This questionnaire has three parts. Part A includes 24 items concerning solid foods, Part B includes 3 items on liquids and Part C includes 8 items, namely 6 items on the impact of dysphagia at meal times and 2 items on discomfort related to thick saliva. Each item offers 5 choices of descriptive answers. Parts A and B also include an option 'I cannot answer'. The participant must carefully read the instructions and check the answer that best corresponds to their situation for each item.

Label: Assessment of pinch strengh using B & L gauge
Definition: An evaluation procedure that uses a B&L gauge to assess pinch strengh. The test measuring the force of the lateral clamps, between the thumb and the index finger, allows quantifying the maximum voluntary strength of the hand and forearm muscles during a pinching action. This is an indicator of the level of hand function.

Label: Assessment of the maximum isometric muscle strength using MedUP dynamometer
Definition: Assessment of the maximum isometric muscle strength of flexor and extensor muscles using MedUP dynamometer. It assesses the maximum isometric muscle strength in upper and lower limbs.
Assesses Phenotype (label): Shoulder girdle muscle weakness|Late-onset proximal muscle weakness|Quadriceps muscle weakness|Late-onset distal muscle weakness|Proximal muscle weakness in upper limbs|Proximal upper limb muscle weakness|Progressive distal muscle weakness|Progressive proximal muscle weakness|Hip flexor weakness

Label: Assessment of tongue strengh using Iowa Oral Performance Instrument
Definition: Assessment of the strengh of the tongue muscle by using Iowa Oral Performance Instrument.

Label: Assessment using Berg Balance Scale
Definition: An assessment with the Berg scale assesses balance and identifies the level of fall risk. This five-level ordinal scale (0 to 4) contains 14 items and the maximum total score ranges from 0 (maximum reach) to 56 (no reach detected). This generic scale evaluates various dimensions of balance, including the following: maintaining multiple positions, having automatic postural responses when changing posture or voluntary movements of the limbs, and produce effective balance and protection reactions.

Label: 10 Meter Walk Test (10MWT)
Definition: The 10mwt is a capacity test that evaluates the subject’s walking speed over a short distance for two different conditions, first at comfortable speed and then at maximum speed.

Label: Assessment using Sydney Swallow Questionnaire (SSQ)
Definition: The Sydney swallowing questionnaire is a self-reported questionnaire that aims to assess the severity of swallowing problems. It contains 17 questions. The participant answers questions 1 to 11 and 13 to 17 by drawing an X on a line (analogue visual scale questions) and question 12 by checking the answer of their choice among 6 options. A validated French-Canadian version has been created.

Label: 80 ml water swallowing test
Definition: The goal of the 80 ml water swallowing test is to swallow the quickliest possible water without choking.

Label: Assessment using Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS)
Definition: Assessment using Fatigue Severity scale. It follows a 9-item scale which measures the severity of fatigue and its effect on a person's activities and lifestyle in patients with a variety of disorders.  A 9-item questionnaire with questions related to how fatigue interferes with certain activities and rates its severity according to a self-report scale. The items are scored on a 7 point scale with 1 = strongly disagree and 7= strongly agree. The minimum score = 9 and maximum score possible = 63. Higher the score = greater fatigue severity. Another way of scoring: mean of all the scores with minimum score being 1 and maximum score being 7. Lerdal (2011) found that items 1 and 2 in the FSS-9 should not be used in a mean score because the FSS-7 shows better validity and reliability and is likely more sensitive for measuring change in fatigue.

Label: Assessment using Hand Jamar dynanometer
Definition: Test measuring the grip force allows quantifying the maximum voluntary force of the muscles of the hand and forearm, during a finger flexion action. This is an indicator of the level of hand function.
Assesses Phenotype (label): Weakness of the intrinsic hand muscles|Finger flexor weakness|Weak grip

Label: Stair Climb Test
Definition: The Stair Climb Test evaluates a subject’s ability to climb and descend a 10 steps stair following two different conditions, at comfortable speed and at maximum speed. This test is intended for participants who have the ability to use stairs.

Label: Activity
Definition: An activity is the execution of a task or action by an individual. Activity limitations are difficulties an individual may have in executing activities.

Label: Participation
Definition: A participation is an involvement in a life situation. Participation restrictions are problems an individual may experience in involvement in life situations
